rules.text: HQ 31 before Season 4 (about Dec 31). Each HQ level raises the hero level cap by 5.
Speedups go to HQ 31 first: Age of Oil research, then the HQ build. Universals on troops only after a big loss.
Squad 1 power = the five tanks' hero power + troops. Drone and Overlord add big hero stats for fights (+1.14M and +188K HP per hero), but the game leaves both out of Hero Power, so not this number.
Exclusive Weapons and gear move Squad 1 power most. Skill medals go to squad-wide skills, for fight value.
One Exclusive Weapon to level 20 before the next. Never Tesla.
Wall of Honor shards go to the hero closest to the next 50-level milestone.
Decoration chests: finish a copy count that's one short, otherwise take a new decoration.
Hero-tree tank research before the Tank Mastery tree.
One queue stays on the Age of Oil until Base Expansion.
Troop slots raise total power, not Squad 1: its troop share held at 9.33M while unit power rose 23M.
Light spend: season pass first, then blueprint packs on sale.

recaps.sources: Heroes video (all 31), hero stat breakdowns / power details / Wall of Honor video, research / drone / Overlord video, squads video, site checklist and notes, decoration gallery video, power details screenshot, Squad 3 screenshot

Your note: the Overlord adds 0 to Squad 1. Hero details show it gives every hero +4,674 attack and +188K HP, but Hero Power has no Overlord row, and the 31 heroes add up exactly without it. Same for the drone (+1.14M HP per hero).

HQ 31 check: about 100-130 research days left on the path plus the 47-day build. That needs about 95-125 speedup days by Dec 31, out of about 165 from stores. Still on track if they go here.
